solutions.title: DFS with separate visited matrix
solutions.strategy: Start DFS from every matching cell and track used cells in a separate boolean matrix.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each cell can start a search, and each word position branches to neighboring cells in the worst case.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The visited matrix stores all cells and the recursion stack can grow to the word length.

solutions.title: DFS with in-place marking
solutions.strategy: Temporarily mark the current board cell during DFS and restore it after exploring neighbors.

timeComplexity.explanation: The branching search complexity is unchanged, but each state uses constant extra bookkeeping.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Only the recursion stack grows with the word length; the board itself stores visited marks temporarily.
